description.zh: 幂等参数。默认为空，长度不超过100个字符。相同的ClientToken的多次调用，只会执行一次创建操作。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. By default, this parameter is left empty. The token cannot exceed 100 characters in length. Requests with the same ClientToken triggers only one creation.
